cards.back: Electricity: 3 Circuits and their Components Nihal and his classmates were excited for their school trip to the Bhakra Nangal Dam.

cards.front: What should you remember from Electricity: Circuits and their Components?
cards.back: There they would visit the hydroelectric power house where the force of falling water was used to generate electricity.

cards.front: What should you remember from Electricity: Circuits and their Components?
cards.back: They also looked forward to the free 13 kilometre- train ride from Nangal in Punjab to Bhakra in Himachal Pradesh, along the beautiful Sutlej river and through the Shivalik hills.

cards.front: What should you remember from Electricity: Circuits and their Components?
cards.back: Prior to the trip, Nihal and his classmates were given a group assignment to prepare a presentation on the uses of electricity.

cards.front: What should you remember from Electricity: Circuits and their Components?
cards.back: They began by looking around their houses, then their school, followed by their neighbourhood, their city, and ﬁnally they searched the internet.
